items.title: Kering Q3 2026: Shares Sink as Gucci Recovery Lags
items.summary: Kering Q3 2026 results: group revenue EUR3.3bn (-1% comparable); Gucci revenue EUR1.3bn, down 6% comparable/4% reported; Gucci direct retail sales down 7% reported/9% comparable; North America turned negative after several growth quarters; Kering raised 2026 net store-closure target from 100 to at least 125. Stock fell sharply on the print. Negative earnings/momentum signal directly relevant to NA (NA turned negative). Outside the 72h window but retained as the most recent hard financial data point on Gucci NA performance; flagged as dated (>14 days would be excluded, this is within 14 days... actually 26 days old) -- RETAINED WITH FLAG: see note.
